verifyAge.title: AGE VERIFICATION
verifyAge.subtitle: Once, and never again. UncutTV is 18+ — we have to check this before you start your first film.
verifyAge.need1: A valid photo ID — national ID card, passport or driving licence
verifyAge.howItWorks: You photograph your ID and take a selfie. Our partner Veriff checks both. We never see your ID ourselves — only the result reaches us.
verifyAge.privacyNote: What happens to your data is set out in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
verifyAge.startError: Verification could not be started. Please try again.
verifyAge.pendingText: We received your data. The check usually takes only a few minutes — this page updates itself.
verifyAge.pendingHint: You can close this window. Once the check is done, you are in at your next sign-in.
verifyAge.declinedText: The check was not successful. This usually happens with blurry photos, expired IDs or poor lighting. You can try again.
verifyAge.resubmissionText: The images could not be evaluated. Use good lighting, fit the whole ID in frame and avoid reflections.
verifyAge.needHelp: Not working? Write to us at <support>support@uncuttv.at</support>.

subscribe.title: COMPLETE YOUR SUBSCRIPTION
subscribe.subtitle: You need an active subscription to access all films. The first seven days are free, after that you can cancel at the end of any month.
subscribe.voucherHint: Got a voucher code? <redeem>Redeem it here</redeem>.

paymentFailed.title: PAYMENT FAILED
paymentFailed.lead: Your payment could not be processed. Nothing was charged.
paymentFailed.accessNote: We will automatically retry over the next few days. Your access stays active until then — if the payment remains open, it will be paused.
paymentFailed.reason1: The card has expired or has been blocked
paymentFailed.reason2: The limit or the available balance is not sufficient
paymentFailed.reason3: The bank declined the payment, for example because authorisation was missing
paymentFailed.reason4: Billing address or security code do not match
paymentFailed.portalError: The billing portal could not be opened. Please try again.
paymentFailed.needHelp: Still stuck? Write to us at <support>support@uncuttv.at</support>.

cancellation.title: CANCEL CONTRACTS HERE
cancellation.intro: Use this form to cancel your contract with UncutTV GmbH. You do not need to be signed in. After submitting you will receive a confirmation by email containing the content of your cancellation as well as the date and time it was received.
cancellation.typeOrdinaryHint: Termination at the regular end of the contract.
cancellation.emailHint: We will send the confirmation to this address.
cancellation.reviewIntro: Please check your details. Your cancellation is only declared once you click “Cancel now”.
cancellation.doneIntro: We have received your cancellation. A confirmation has been sent to the address you provided.
cancellation.doneNextPossibleNote: We will confirm the exact termination date separately, once we have matched your cancellation to your contract.
cancellation.errorRequired: Please fill in all required fields.
cancellation.errorEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
cancellation.errorReason: Please state the reason for the extraordinary cancellation.
cancellation.errorDatePast: The date must not be in the past.
cancellation.errorSubmit: The cancellation could not be submitted. Please try again or write to office@uncuttv.at.
